examples.chinese: 中文老師每天都給我們作業。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwén lǎoshī měi tiān dōu gěi wǒmen zuòyè.
examples.english: The Chinese teacher gives us homework every day.

examples.chinese: 桌子上放著很多張紙，都是弟弟要寫的書法作業。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe hěn duō zhāng zhǐ, dōu shì dìdi yào xiě de shūfǎ zuòyè.
examples.english: There are many sheets of paper placed on the table; they are all the calligraphy homework that my younger brother needs to write.

examples.chinese: 我得寫完作業，才可以跟你去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děi xiě wán zuòyè, cái kěyǐ gēn nǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I have to finish my homework; only then can I go to the movies with you.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese:
媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了。
今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
examples.pinyin:
Māma bǎ fàng zài yuànzi lǐ de yī duī kōng píngzi, kōng guànzi dōu rēng le.
Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yī piān zuòwén, kěshì wǒ de nǎozi kōngkōng de, yī gè zì yě xiě bù chūlái.
examples.english:
Mom threw away all the empty bottles and empty cans that were placed in the yard.
Today's homework is to write a composition, but my mind is completely empty; I can't write a single word.

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

examples.chinese: 週六你到我家來寫作業，或者我們一起到圖書館去讀書也行。
examples.pinyin: Zhōuliù nǐ dào wǒ jiā lái xiě zuòyè, huòzhě wǒmen yīqǐ dào túshūguǎn qù dúshū yě xíng.
examples.english: On Saturday you can come to my house to do homework, or we can go to the library together to study—that works too.

examples.chinese: 我明天要把這份作業交給老師，遲了老師就不收了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào bǎ zhè fèn zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī, chí le lǎoshī jiù bù shōu le.
examples.english: I need to hand this homework to the teacher tomorrow; if it's late, the teacher won't accept it.

items.wordHook: 作(make) + 業(work) → the work you make yourself do: homework.

examples.chinese: 他住的那棟大樓附近有學校，也有餐廳。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù de nà dòng dàlóu fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yě yǒu cāntīng.
examples.english: Near the building where he lives there is a school, and also a restaurant.

examples.chinese: 台北市在台灣的北部，有很多大樓。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Shì zài Táiwān de běibù, yǒu hěn duō dàlóu.
examples.english: Taipei City is in northern Taiwan and has many tall buildings.

examples.chinese: 台北101大樓的樣子看起來就像竹子一樣節節高升。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi 101 dàlóu de yàngzi kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng zhúzi yíyàng jiéjié gāoshēng.
examples.english: The appearance of the Taipei 101 building looks just like bamboo, rising higher section by section.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的變化很大，不少老房屋已經變成新大樓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà, bùshǎo lǎo fángwū yǐjīng biànchéng xīn dàlóu le.
examples.english: This city has changed a lot; many old houses have already turned into new high-rise buildings.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng dàlóu fāshēng huǒzāi shí, hái hǎo ānquán rényuán hěn lěngjìng, cái néng dài zhe dàjiā ānquán de líkāi.
examples.english: When that building caught fire, fortunately the safety personnel were very calm, so they were able to lead everyone to leave safely.

examples.chinese:
那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。
這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin:
Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi.
Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english:
The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically.
This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 王先生投資生意的眼光很好，讓他僅僅一年就買下了好幾棟大樓。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng tóuzī shēngyì de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, ràng tā jǐnjǐn yī nián jiù mǎi xià le hǎo jǐ dòng dàlóu.
examples.english: Mr. Wang's eye for investing in business is very good; it made him buy several buildings in just one year.

examples.chinese: 根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù běn dàlóu de guǎnlǐ guīdìng, sīrén wùpǐn bùkě duī zài gōnggòng qūyù.
examples.english: According to the management rules of this building, personal items may not be piled up in public areas.

examples.chinese: 這個菜放了太多鹽，鹹死了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài fàng le tài duō yán, xián sǐ le.
examples.english: This dish has too much salt in it; it's salty to death.

examples.chinese: 吃太鹹或太甜的東西，對身體都不好。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài xián huò tài tián de dōngxi, duì shēntǐ dōu bù hǎo.
examples.english: Eating things that are too salty or too sweet is not good for your health.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: 那道菜一點兒都不鹹，我猜或許是忘了放鹽巴。
examples.pinyin: Nà dào cài yìdiǎnr dōu bù xián, wǒ cāi huòxǔ shì wàngle fàng yánbā.
examples.english: That dish isn't salty at all; I guess maybe they forgot to add salt.

examples.chinese: 我最近皮膚又紅又癢，暫時不能吃太辣或太鹹的食物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn pífū yòu hóng yòu yǎng, zànshí bùnéng chī tài là huò tài xián de shíwù.
examples.english: Recently my skin has been red and itchy, so for the time being I can't eat food that is too spicy or too salty.

examples.chinese: 媽媽有時候會跟市場的老闆講價，希望價錢能便宜一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Māma yǒu shíhou huì gēn shìchǎng de lǎobǎn jiǎngjià, xīwàng jiàqián néng piányi yìdiǎnr.
examples.english: Mom sometimes bargains with the market vendors, hoping the price can be a little cheaper.

examples.chinese: 他是這個社區的安全人員，負責大家的安全。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì zhège shèqū de ānquán rényuán, fùzé dàjiā de ānquán.
examples.english: He is the security staff of this community, responsible for everyone's safety.

examples.chinese: 每次出國時，機場的安全人員都會檢查我們的護照和行李。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì chūguó shí, jīchǎng de ānquán rényuán dōu huì jiǎnchá wǒmen de hùzhào hé xíngli.
examples.english: Every time we go abroad, the airport security staff check our passports and luggage.

examples.chinese:
因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。
這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō.
Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english:
Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast.
There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese:
氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。
老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin:
Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn.
Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english:
The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs.
The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng dàlóu fāshēng huǒzāi shí, hái hǎo ānquán rényuán hěn lěngjìng, cái néng dài zhe dàjiā ānquán de líkāi.
examples.english: When that building caught fire, fortunately the safety personnel were very calm, so they were able to lead everyone to leave safely.

examples.chinese:
公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。
地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin:
Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng.
Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english:
The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it.
Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese:
那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。
總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin:
Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá.
Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english:
That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather.
Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese:
這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。
A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin:
Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí.
A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english:
This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel.
A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 過海關時，請配合相關人員檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Guò hǎiguān shí, qǐng pèihé xiāngguān rényuán jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: When going through customs, please cooperate with the relevant personnel in inspecting your luggage.

examples.chinese: 演唱會開演前，工作人員請大家不要拿手機錄現場的情況。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì kāiyǎn qián, gōngzuò rényuán qǐng dàjiā bùyào ná shǒujī lù xiànchǎng de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Before the concert begins, the staff ask everyone not to use their phones to record the scene.

examples.chinese: 你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dài zhe yāoqǐngkǎ gěi ménkǒu de fúwù rényuán jiǎnchá, cái néng rùchǎng cānjiā huódòng.
examples.english: You bring your invitation card for the service staff at the entrance to check, and only then can you enter the venue to participate in the event.

examples.chinese: 班機起飛前，服務人員都會為旅客說明應注意的安全規定。
examples.pinyin: Bānjī qǐfēi qián, fúwù rényuán dōu huì wèi lǚkè shuōmíng yīng zhùyì de ānquán guīdìng.
examples.english: Before the flight takes off, the service staff will explain the safety regulations that should be noted to the passengers.

examples.chinese: 如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùdào wúfǎ chǔlǐ de xīnlǐ wèntí, zuìhǎo qǐng zhuānyè rényuán lái fǔdǎo.
examples.english: If you encounter psychological problems you cannot handle, it's best to ask professionals to give guidance.

items.key: ["B2L09-2-22","华语文中心","華語（文）中心","华语（文）中心","Ph"]

examples.chinese: 我跟華語文中心的美國學生語言交換，他教我英文，我教他中文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn de Měiguó xuéshēng yǔyán jiāohuàn, tā jiāo wǒ Yīngwén, wǒ jiāo tā Zhōngwén.
examples.english: I do a language exchange with an American student at the Mandarin Training Center; he teaches me English, and I teach him Chinese.

examples.chinese: 昨天華語中心辦的中秋節活動，所有學生都來參加了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān Huáyǔ zhōngxīn bàn de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, suǒyǒu xuéshēng dōu lái cānjiā le.
examples.english: At the Mid-Autumn Festival activity held by the Mandarin Center yesterday, all the students came to participate.

examples.chinese: 華語文中心的學生都很會跳舞，其中跳得最好的是非洲學生。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn de xuésheng dōu hěn huì tiàowǔ, qízhōng tiào de zuì hǎo de shì Fēizhōu xuésheng.
examples.english: The students at the Mandarin Learning Center are all very good at dancing; among them, the one who dances the best is the African student.

examples.chinese: 華語文中心的學生邀請台灣朋友來參加世界文化日的活動。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn de xuésheng yāoqǐng Táiwān péngyou lái cānjiā shìjiè wénhuà rì de huódòng.
examples.english: The students at the Mandarin Learning Center invited Taiwanese friends to come participate in the World Culture Day activities.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 華語中心的學生想在臺灣的銀行開戶，得先準備在學證明。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn de xuésheng xiǎng zài Táiwān de yínháng kāihù, děi xiān zhǔnbèi zàixué zhèngmíng.
examples.english: Students at the Mandarin Training Center who want to open an account at a bank in Taiwan must first prepare a certificate of enrollment.

examples.chinese: 王教授推薦我去念那個研究所的翻譯課程。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuījiàn wǒ qù niàn nàge yánjiūsuǒ de fānyì kèchéng.
examples.english: Professor Wang recommended that I go study the translation course at that graduate institute.

examples.chinese: 妹妹知道自己考上了最好的研究所，激動地哭了起來。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei zhīdào zìjǐ kǎo shàng le zuì hǎo de yánjiūsuǒ, jīdòng de kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When my younger sister learned that she had gotten into the best graduate school, she was so excited that she started crying.

examples.chinese: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén nénglì yǐ dádào xiāngdāng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn, zài Táiwān niàn yánjiūsuǒ méi wèntí.
examples.english: His Chinese ability has already reached a fairly good level; studying at a graduate school in Taiwan is no problem.

examples.chinese: 如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tóngshì zhījiān bú yuànyì gōutōng, zhège huìyì zěnme kāi xiàqù ne?
examples.english: If colleagues are unwilling to communicate with each other, how can this meeting continue?

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

items.wordHook: Stepping 下(below) into or toward 去(go): 下去 means continuously.
Combining 道(method) and 教(education): 道教 means Taoism.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese:
理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。
著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin:
Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng.
Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english:
In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation.
The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese:
科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。
網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin:
Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí.
Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english:
Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life.
The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese:
我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。
費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái.
Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english:
Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it.
Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese:
那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。
這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin:
Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi.
Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english:
The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically.
This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese:
不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。
九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin:
Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng.
Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english:
I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction.
The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese:
大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。
先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin:
Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě.
Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english:
Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand.
The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.
examples.english: Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper.

examples.chinese: 這個路口很危險，經常發生車禍。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lùkǒu hěn wēixiǎn, jīngcháng fāshēng chēhuò.
examples.english: This intersection is very dangerous; car accidents often happen here.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese:
強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。
小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin:
Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān.
Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english:
A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach.
Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese:
公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。
地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin:
Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng.
Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english:
The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it.
Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: A:小張病了三天了，不但全身沒力，還發高燒。 B:最近很多人都這樣，應該是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Zhāng bìng le sān tiān le, bùdàn quánshēn méi lì, hái fā gāoshāo. B: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén dōu zhèyàng, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.
examples.english: A: Xiao Zhang has been ill for three days; not only does his whole body have no strength, but he also has a high fever. B: Many people have been like this recently; it's probably a cold.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng dàlóu fāshēng huǒzāi shí, hái hǎo ānquán rényuán hěn lěngjìng, cái néng dài zhe dàjiā ānquán de líkāi.
examples.english: When that building caught fire, fortunately the safety personnel were very calm, so they were able to lead everyone to leave safely.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese:
因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。
不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le.
Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english:
Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over.
Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese:
地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。
當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin:
Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng.
Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english:
During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury.
When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu xiānsheng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēnpí zuò de shāfā, zuò qǐlái hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Mr. Zhou bought a set of sofas made of genuine leather; they are very comfortable to sit on.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 黃先生這幾天一直發燒，腦子很不清楚，恐怕沒辦法寫劇本。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng zhè jǐ tiān yīzhí fāshāo, nǎozi hěn bù qīngchu, kǒngpà méi bànfǎ xiě jùběn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang has had a fever for the past few days, his brain is very unclear, and I'm afraid he won't be able to write the script.

examples.chinese: 國安發燒了，不能來上課，我有點兒擔心他。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè, wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn tā.
examples.english: Guo'an has a fever and cannot come to class; I am a little worried about him.

examples.chinese: 弟弟發燒了，他要請假。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi fāshāo le, tā yào qǐngjià.
examples.english: My younger brother has a fever, and he needs to ask for leave.

examples.chinese: 客廳裡面有兩張沙發。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng zhāng shāfā.
examples.english: There are two sofas in the living room.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 沙發下面呢？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā xiàmiàn ne?
examples.english: How about checking under the sofa?

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

items.wordHook: Braced 癶(legs) and a drawn 弓(bow) take aim → the 殳(striking hand) lets it fly: 發(send).

examples.chinese: A:你快點把衣服換好。還不出門，就趕不上飛機嘍？ B:好啦，我知道了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ kuài diǎn bǎ yīfu huàn hǎo. Hái bù chūmén, jiù gǎn bù shàng fēijī lou? B: Hǎo la, wǒ zhīdào le.
examples.english: A: Hurry up and get changed. If you don't leave now, you won't catch the plane, you know? B: Okay, I got it.

examples.chinese: 如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo lìyòng shíwù cáiliào, jiù néng yǒuxiào de jiǎnshǎo chúyú.
examples.english: If food materials can be used well, kitchen waste can be effectively reduced.

examples.chinese: 我看到前面有人跟我揮手，可是我不認識那個人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào qiánmiàn yǒu rén gēn wǒ huī shǒu, kěshì wǒ bù rènshí nàge rén.
examples.english: I saw someone in front waving at me, but I don't know that person.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào zìjǐ guójiā de guóqí jìnrù Àoyùn huìchǎng, mínzhòng yě búduàn huī zhe shǒu shàng de xiǎo qízi, tì zìjǐ de guójiā jiāyóu.
examples.english: Seeing their country's national flag enter the Olympic venue, the public also continuously waved the small flags in their hands to cheer for their country.

examples.chinese: 假如人人都發揮人性美好的一面，就能給社會帶來和平。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú rénrén dōu fāhuī rénxìng měihǎo de yī miàn, jiù néng gěi shèhuì dàilái hépíng.
examples.english: If everyone brings out the beautiful side of human nature, then it can bring peace to society.

examples.chinese: 從國外坐飛機到臺灣來，有時需要轉機。
examples.pinyin: Cóng guówài zuò fēijī dào Táiwān lái, yǒushí xūyào zhuǎnjī.
examples.english: When flying from abroad to Taiwan, sometimes you need to transfer flights.

examples.chinese: 台灣這場地震的規模很大，使許多人受輕傷、重傷。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zhè chǎng dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, shǐ xǔduō rén shòu qīngshāng, zhòngshāng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake in Taiwan was very large, causing many people to suffer minor and serious injuries.

items.wordHook: 先(first) + 生(born) → the one born first is the elder, so 先生 is a respectful 'Mr.' (or husband).
To 學(learn) a 問(ask about): 學問 means learning, knowledge.
A sincere 心(heart) sealed with a decisive diagonal stroke 丿(slash) marks a vow that will 必(surely) come true.
a 方(direction) banner rests over a 𠂉(lying person) and followers → a 旅(journey).
a 疒(sickness) takes hold on the 丙(third) floor → one bad case of 病(sickness).
To 請(ask) a 求(beg): 請求 means ask.
